event_chain.summary: GitHub access of a departing engineer, compromised through the TanStack supply chain attack, used to clone repositories

summary: In September 2026 attackers linked to the Shai-Hulud/TeamPCP supply chain campaigns used a departing engineer's still-active GitHub access, compromised through the TanStack attack, to steal source code from CrowdSec's repositories. The theft came to light on September 16 when the code was posted on a public forum; CrowdSec confirmed about 300 repositories were affected.
